items.title: RealBlindingEDR Tool That kills or Permanently Turn off AV/EDR Using Kernel Callbacks
items.description: An open-source tool called RealBlindingEDR enables attackers to blind, permanently disable, or terminate antivirus (AV) and endpoint detection and response (EDR) software by clearing critical kernel callbacks on Windows systems. Released on GitHub in late 2023, the utility leverages signed drivers for arbitrary memory read and write operations, bypassing protections like PatchGuard to target six…

items.title: SonicWall SSLVPN Under Attack Following the Breach of All Customers’ Firewall Backups
items.description: A surge in attacks targeting SonicWall SSLVPN devices, affecting numerous customer networks, just weeks after a major breach exposed sensitive firewall data. Starting October 4, 2025, threat actors have rapidly authenticated into over 100 accounts across 16 environments, using what appear to be stolen valid credentials rather than brute-force methods.
